title: Правда о Гуле  (The Truth About Gulya)

segments.t: At the bar during the wedding celebration, Ainura cannot hold back the secret any longer: Gulya has no fiancé in Bishkek! Her migration card expired, banning her from returning to Moscow for five years, and she lied so she wouldn't ruin Lyova's life.
В Бишкеке у неё никого нет.
В Москву приедет через пять лет.
У тебя здесь работа и мама.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Gulya will kill me for this.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Gulya' and 'will kill' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'But I cannot keep silent.' Ainura brings out the contrast between 'but' and 'I' in a few short words.
В Бишкеке у неё никого нет.
'She has nobody in Bishkek.' In Russian, the idea of 'Bishkek' flows naturally into 'no' without extra filler words.
'She loves only you alone.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'she' and finishing on 'loves'. Lyova answers right away.
'Then why did she lie to me?' Lyova brings out the contrast between 'why' and 'but' in a few short words.
'Her migration card expired yesterday.' Notice the reflexive suffix on the verb meaning 'expired', turning the action back on the subject.
'Now she has to fly away urgently.' In Russian, the idea of 'now' flows naturally into 'need' without extra filler words.
В Москву приедет через пять лет.
'She will come to Moscow in five years.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Moscow' and finishing on 'years'.
У тебя здесь работа и мама.
'You have your work and mother here.' Ainura brings out the contrast between 'at' and 'you' in a few short words.
'She decided not to stand in your way.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'she' before landing on 'to disturb'.
'In two hours she will fly away.' Ainura brings out the contrast between 'two' and 'hours' in a few short words.
'Lyova, run after her quickly!' In Russian, the idea of 'Lyova' flows naturally into 'her' without extra filler words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
В Бишкеке у неё никого нет.
В Москву приедет через пять лет.
У тебя здесь работа и мама.
Just as Lyova stands up to race to the airport after Gulya, Chef Barinov taps his glass to make a major announcement about Lyova's career. See you in the next scene.

lines.fragment: Но я не могу это держать
Вот теперь в Москву только через пять лет она приедет
А у тебя же здесь работа, жизнь, мама
И она решила тебе не мешать
